content:
Apple is now releasing the second release candidate (RC) versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, exactly one week after the first RC of macOS 26.7 leaked revealing several new product details.

macOS 26.7 and macOS 15.8 RC 2 are now available

Developers can now install macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 RC 2, just days after the first macOS 26.7 release candidate leaked a number of new product details, including a video of AirPods with cameras and several technical specifics.

This release also includes the developer beta 7 of macOS 27 Golden Gate, with a public beta expected to follow shortly thereafter.

Ironically, despite last week's leaks, macOS 26.7 appears to be shaping up to be a fairly uneventful release, as Apple winds down major development of macOS 26 in the weeks leading up to macOS 27 Golden Gate. Meanwhile, macOS Sequoia 15.8 is expected to include important security fixes, some of which may also be included in macOS Tahoe 26.7.

That said, we're digging into the new code from this release and will let you know if we come across anything noteworthy. The build number for macOS 26.7 RC 2 is 25G224, while the build number for macOS 15.8 is 24H20.

Did you find any new features in this RC release? Let us know in the comments.
